title: The Infinite Salt Marsh

features.name: salt crystalline node
features.desc-on-touch: Salt has learned to hold information. These crystals remember every tide that made them. Beside them, the archive's casing draws power from the memory the salt still carries.

features.name: circuit-marsh current
features.desc-on-touch: Water moves through the board-ground like electricity through trace. The marsh and the circuit have learned to speak the same grammar. Neither moves the other. Both persist.

features.name: tidal platform
features.desc-on-touch: Here the land becomes neither land nor water. The platform holds the boundary. The archive files its comparison: salt meets fresh meets memory, and all three become each other.

features.name: cordgrass spine
features.desc-on-touch: The grass holds the boundary too. Its roots reach into salt water. Its shoots reach toward fresh air. It doesn't choose. It holds both. The corruption copies this—it learned to be two things at once here.

inscription: where salt and silence learned to file themselves as one record, the marsh became a living archive
